developer.bio: By day, Karat is a biomedical and research scientist. His research has taken him to places like Texas A&M University and the University of Vermont. He writes software for the fun of solving his own problems, and Glyph is one of those tools.

newNotes.sectionDescription: Choose where Glyph creates new notes in this space.

defaultFolder.label: Default folder
defaultFolder.description: New Note and Cmd+N create notes here when a folder is set.

language.sectionDescription: Choose the language used across Glyph.
language.label: Language
language.description: Applies immediately to menus, settings, and navigation.
language.communityNotice: Translations are community-contributed and may be incomplete. Questions or improvements? <discord>Join Discord</discord>.

dateTime.sectionDescription: Choose how complete dates appear across Glyph.

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.description: Applies immediately to complete dates in notes, metadata, databases, and history.

openPreviousTabs.label: Open previous tabs
openPreviousTabs.description: Start this space with the tabs you left open.

experimental.sectionDescription: Experimental features that are not fully fleshed out. A later version of Glyph may change or remove them.

noteSidePeek.label: Note peek
noteSidePeek.description: Wiki links and All Notes open as a Peek over the current tab instead of replacing it. Expand the Peek to go to that note, or close it to stay where you were. The file tree and command palette still open tabs.

zenMode.label: Zen mode
zenMode.description: Hide the sidebars, tabs, editor controls, and formatting ribbon so only your note remains.

editor.sectionDescription: Controls for editing behavior and note structure inside Glyph.

defaultEditorMode.label: Default editor mode
defaultEditorMode.description: How notes open by default: Rich for editing, Preview for read-only viewing, or Raw for plain Markdown.

focusMode.label: Focus mode
focusMode.description: Dim inactive text in the main Rich editor while keeping your current writing unit clear.

tableOfContents.label: Table of contents
tableOfContents.description: Show a floating table of contents for each note.

showFrontmatter.label: Show frontmatter in editor
showFrontmatter.description: Display YAML frontmatter at the top of notes while editing. Turning this off keeps frontmatter available to indexing and databases.

headingPrefixes.label: Heading prefixes
headingPrefixes.description: Show H1-H6 labels beside headings in the rich text editor.

colorfulHeadings.label: Colorful headings
colorfulHeadings.description: Use a selected color palette for H1-H6 while editing notes.

collapsibleHeadings.label: Collapsible headings
collapsibleHeadings.description: Show collapse toggles on note headings in editor and preview.

collapsibleLists.label: Collapsible lists
collapsibleLists.description: Show collapse toggles on nested lists in editor and preview.

spellCheck.label: Spell check
spellCheck.description: Underline typos as you type. Right-click a word to see spelling suggestions.

vimMode.title: Vim Mode
vimMode.label: Vim Mode
vimMode.info: Vim Mode is available only in Raw Markdown mode.

formatBar.label: Formatting bar
formatBar.description: Show the bottom formatting bar in Rich editor mode.

folderCounts.label: Show folder file counts
folderCounts.description: Show a recursive file total at the end of each folder row in the file tree.

sort.label: File tree sort
sort.description: Choose how folders and files are ordered in the sidebar tree.

week.label: Weekly notes
week.description: One note for this ISO week.

editorPresentation.sectionDescription: Choose how notes look while you edit them.

beautifulTags.label: Beautiful Tags
beautifulTags.description: Enable the experimental Beautiful Tags presentation for tags.

editorWidth.label: Editor width
editorWidth.description: Compact keeps lines shorter, Comfortable gives a little bit more room, and Wide uses the full editor width.
